verdict.rationale: The API docs say agents can be triggered from CI/CD pipelines when builds fail. The Python SDK (`agent.run(prompt=...)`) and the CLI ('create new agents') give scriptable, non-interactive ways to start cloud agent runs, and logs and traces can be retrieved through the API. Missing for 10: documented non-interactive CLI flags or exit-code behavior for shell scripts, concrete CI integration examples (e.g., a GitHub Actions workflow), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
